data.standardized_narrative: At the 2021 year end the syndicate's gross prior-year reserve estimates for underwriting years older than 2020 moved adversely by approximately $26.8m (about 4.0% of opening gross claims outstanding), representing a gross strengthening of reserves. This adverse development was concentrated in older casualty exposures (notably adverse development on the 2018 account in Construction and Binding sub-classes) and reflects a combination of adverse prior claims development, large individual losses and social inflation/litigation trends. The reported net prior-year deterioration (net of reinsurance) was $7.832m; the gross movement was derived from the syndicate's gross claims development triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $196,366,000 (2020: $172,472,000) is a deterioration of $7,832,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $6,620,000).
The calendar year result was also impacted by adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years in the Non-Marine Liability class.
The 2018 year has experienced further adverse loss experience in the Construction and Binders sub-classes from a number of individual large losses.
The class has been further affected by social inflation, whereby we have seen an increase in the frequency of claims and a higher percentage of insureds making claims.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure provided is the gross estimate derived from the published gross claims development triangle (gross incurred claims by underwriting year). The report also explicitly states a net prior-year deterioration of $7.832m (net of reinsurance) - that net figure is quoted in the notes and used for narrative but the primary required field uses gross movement calculated from the triangle. The opening reserves figure is taken from the prior-year comparative 'Claims outstanding' on the Balance Sheet. All monetary amounts are reported in the syndicate's native currency (USD) and expressed in millions. No per-line gross PYD amounts were provided in the notes; LOB attributions for the PYD are inferred from narrative statements. RITC of 2017 and prior was transferred out to Syndicate 1994 which has been noted in the report; however the gross triangle used excludes 2017 & prior columns and therefore is considered appropriate for the PYD calculation.
